newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's regional bank shares down on Hanwa news.
newsitem.headline: Japan's regional bank shares down on Hanwa news.

text.p: Shares in some Japanese regional banks were lower on Thursday morning, pushed down by news that the Finance Ministry was halting most operations of Hanwa Bank Ltd, traders said.
Bank of Kinki's shares were down 60 yen at 790 yen at 0056 GMT, on volume of 149,000 shares.
Shares in Fukutoku Bank dropped 10 yen to 277 yen, on volume of 172,000 shares.
Bank of Osaka was ask-only at 320 yen at 0058 GMT, against its Wednesday's closing at 335 yen.
Hanwa Bank is a second-tier regional bank operating mainly in the Osaka region, and the banks whose shares dropped in the morning were the ones operating in the same region.
Before the market opened on Thursday, the Osaka Securities Exchange (OSE) said it would suspend trading of Hanwa Bank shares for the whole day.
